properties.description: Drives search_design through the MCP surface (call_tool, an in-process client: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/one_search_reaches_every_design_a_hub_tracks.rs) and through the --call door on the real binary and real stores (tests/a_local_hub_searches_its_pinned_designs_through_the_door.rs) on a design that pins others. Asserts: (1) a node held ONLY in a pinned design's export is returned under that design, its id prefixed, for a Component, a Requirement and a Decision, and the design's own hit is there unprefixed; (2) a missing export, a pin at an address (not_reached, never fetched: revised 2026-10-21 from 'searched on a stand-in server', which is cap:a-tracked-search-reaches-a-design-at-its-address, planned), a pin with nowhere to read it, a file that is not a design, and an export of another design each come back in not_searched with a state and a sentence, a code dependency never; (3) the one limit bounds the merged list and hits_withheld counts what fell outside, and an empty answer says what was not searched; (4) without tracked_designs (or with false) the reply is unchanged; (5) a design that pins nothing says so; (6) a hit opens with get_node by its prefixed id or by member, an id both designs hold reads each design's own, an absent id says why, a read aimed where nothing reads is refused with the state; (7) a write aimed at a pinned design is refused and the export's bytes are unchanged, while a write merely naming a prefixed id in its words stays the hub's.
properties.findings: 8 passed on feat/p7-tracked-search-from-exports (7 in memory, 1 on disk through the door). Every one failed on main 001c20951 first: the tracked search refused by the schema (`tracked_designs` is not a parameter), get_node with a prefixed id answering null, and `member` refused off a hub's address.
properties.name: A tracked-designs search finds a node that only a tracked design holds, and names each tracked design it could not search
